# CSS Dice Roller

Vendored from [`@gnuton/css-dice-roller` 0.8.5](https://github.com/gnuton/css-dice-roller), MIT license. The JavaScript and CSS are the package's unmodified `dist/css-dice-roller.js` and `dist/style.css` files. The site uses its CSS 3D dice without a runtime CDN or WebGL dependency.
